_comment: Source entries the Adapters.Tests.ps1 tests read by name. Test data only: these are not running sources.

sources.name: boulder-public-library
sources.notes: LibCal ICS feed, calendar id 12885. It returned 500 events over about 8 weeks, so the feed seems capped at 500. robots.txt allows it with a 10 second crawl delay. Mostly storytimes and recurring programs; consider a title filter. Terms not read. Configured 2026-11-03. fixedVenue, because the feed names rooms (Canyon Theater, Flatirons Room) rather than the branch

sources.name: cu-athletics
sources.notes: All sports, per-event LOCATION. The filter removes away games. Includes dates years out

sources.name: nederland-library
sources.notes: WordPress with The Events Calendar; ?ical=1 and the REST API both work (10 upcoming, no venues). Board meetings and closures are skipped, like the city sources. The site is set to UTC+0, so its times are Boulder wall-clock time labeled UTC; localTimeAsUtc reads them as local (checked 2026-11-08: Festival of Trees shows 4:00 PM on the site and 16:00 in both start_date and utc_start_date). Terms not read

sources.name: boulder-county-fairgrounds
sources.notes: Official calendar for the fairgrounds, mostly consumer shows and markets. Events list individual buildings as venues, so fixedVenue keeps them as Boulder County Fairgrounds

sources.name: colorado-chautauqua
sources.notes: The venue's own RSS feed (RSS event module) at /events/rss: every listed event with start and end times in UTC, the building (Auditorium, Community House, Green) and a type. robots.txt allows everything. The building name follows venuePrefix, and venue-aliases.json folds Colorado Chautauqua Auditorium into Chautauqua Auditorium

sources.name: cu-events-center
sources.notes: One Ticketmaster venue id for the arena

sources.name: colorado-wine
sources.excludeTitlePattern: (?i)happy hour|trivia|growler|board meeting|annual meeting|case sale|first fridays|^settembre cellars\b
sources.notes: Statewide winery events calendar. Suggested 2026-11-07. robots.txt allows everything. The Events Calendar REST API answers with hundreds of upcoming events, almost all weekly repeats posted two years ahead: happy hours, trivia and growler fills, and board meetings. excludeTitlePattern drops those, leaving one-off winery events. No event has a venue object; the winery is only the start of the title (Boulder Creek Winery - Pop-Up Music), so city is Other and refine's city lookup reads the event page. Titles starting "Settembre Cellars" are skipped, because settembre-cellars reads Settembre's own calendar with the real venue.

sources.name: boulder-happenings
sources.notes: Local events aggregator. All-day events report timezone UTC+0, timed events don't

sources.name: eldora-mountain
sources.notes: Ski area above Nederland. robots.txt disallows /wp-json/ and ?rest_route= (so not the tribe adapter) and sets Crawl-delay 10. The site runs The Events Calendar, and /event/?ical=1 is allowed. Most events have no LOCATION, so fixedVenue keeps one key. The site is set to UTC+0: the feed labels Boulder wall-clock time as UTC (Shred Shed is 10:00 AM on the site and DTSTART;TZID=UTC:...T100000), so localTimeAsUtc reads it as local. Tuesday Trivia and Friday Singo are weekly, but the feed lists each as one event from its first date to its last (Dec 2025 to Apr 2027) with no RRULE, so they are skipped rather than shown as one months-long event. Terms not read

sources.name: visit-longmont
sources.notes: Visitor bureau running the Eventastic plugin (Madden Media). /events/ embeds a few events as JSON (window.preLoadData), and the calendar posts action=get_events_date_ordered with start_date and end_date to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php, which returns event_objects (title, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, pattern_dates, addr1, city, permalink, categories). On 2026-11-08 the range to 2027-05-07 held 4 events (56 dates): Trivia Tuesdays at Gunbarrel Brewing, Friday Night Singo in Niwot, Left Hand Thursday Trivia in Longmont, and a chamber Fall Membership Breakfast. Read by the eventastic adapter, one POST a night for the next 180 days. Weekly events are listed once per date. Priority 60, so an organizer's own listing wins when both have an event
